nonblocking_findings.details: Original controller COMPLETE and historical absence are evidenced; its process return code is not recorded. All eight child exits are recorded as 0.
Single-seed, benchmark-selected teacher50+extra50 normal results do not establish +1 success, untouched-test generalization, missing-modality performance or a causal mechanism.
Current remote state/protected weights, external dataset bytes, and historical non-AX raw retrieval matrices were not rechecked. Recorded local receipt bindings are verified.

summary: The AX reported retrieval metrics and complete 600-row terminal F trace are correct within the audited scope. No numerical/result-integrity defect was found. The original controller process return code is unrecorded; qualified single-seed benchmark-selected results remain provisional and the +1 target is unmet.
model_routing_attestation: No independently attested runtime model/effort metadata was supplied. Requested routing is not claimed as actual routing.

findings: Retrieval identities/cameras come from RGBNT100 official-split filenames, not predictions. Training labels are a sorted relabeling of the 50 training identities; those identities are disjoint from the 50 query/gallery identities.

One canonical manifest was independently decoded: 8,675 train, 1,715 query, 8,575 gallery records (18,965 filenames). Three other supplied manifests match it exactly. Four NPZ containers match the same query/gallery names, identities, cameras and scene=-1 metadata in 32 array comparisons.
All eight camera values 0..7 appear; scene=-1 is a constant placeholder, so its single group is not evidence of scene diversity.
Model-derived auxiliary contribution targets are training diagnostics/auxiliary supervision. They are not used as retrieval identity ground truth.
A_ground_truth_provenance.scope_limit: Local manifest/raw-metadata provenance and archived installed-GT audit receipts were checked. No dataset image bytes, external dataset distribution, or current remote installation was accessed.

findings: mAP is mean relevant-rank precision; mINP is relevant count divided by last relevant rank. CMC and Rank-1/5/10/20 use the same same-identity/same-camera exclusion and stable ascending distance order. Percent conversion is multiplication by 100, not division by prediction extrema or a model-dependent denominator.
Feature normalization and FP32 per-head query normalization affect the model/distance calculation; they do not rescale reported retrieval metrics.
Independent saved-distance recount agrees with all corresponding six metrics, CMC1-50, complete per-query fields, and camera/identity/scene groups.

All 341 supplied primary artifact paths exist. All 273 original terminal text-manifest entries match their captured byte counts and SHA256 values. Six original D archives match controller, intake and local archive receipts.

Both AX runs actually contain epochs 1..50 and 6,563 successful updates each (13,126 total), zero AMP skips and coverage of all 8,675 eligible training records. Each run has a fresh native3 record with strict reload and all 111 active parameter-gradient flags true; native total is six updates.

Both AX checkpoints select epoch 16 by maximum full normal benchmark mAP; the maxima are unique. All six metrics, strict reload, best.json, epoch16 and normal11 agree. Eight fixed state cases exist at those same selected checkpoints.

Original controller PID 1828887 has a matching launch record, COMPLETE result and terminal log marker, with historical absence recorded. All eight original native/train/audit/states child launch/exit receipts match the original observer and report exit_code=0 without forced cleanup.

The detached controller itself has no captured process return-code receipt. A COMPLETE marker plus an absent PID does not establish the controller process exit code. No controller exit_code=0 is asserted by this audit.

AX main passes its builder and update into the full-official runner. The runner calls full_metrics after each epoch and after selected-checkpoint strict reload; full_metrics calls evaluate_reid. The fixed-state evaluator calls the same metric path plus independent recount/verify. Terminal logs and saved outputs bind these actual paths.

The legacy full_evaluation.main dev-split path and audit_full_official49.main 49-condition path are not the AX execution entry points. No missing-49 or untouched-final-test result is inferred from those unused entry points.

Original launch-session seals exactly equal the source-review seal maps: 7 new plus 306 reused entries. This reviewer directly rehashed 22 listed original-sealed files (21 Python files and the plan JSON), not all 313 source files. The later closed-trace reducer was read and hashed separately; it is not presented as prelaunch source.

AX wraps only the three F spatial attention.forward methods with the existing AS projected-Q normalization. K/V/output projection operations and cross-band attention are untouched by that wrapper; M query normalization and AV two middle/high value-weight decay0 groups are retained. Both controls receive the same intervention.

All 13,126 AX formal batch records and six native records satisfy the recorded Q-normalization/call-count/zero-extra-update contracts; all 600 terminal AV/AX epoch-band rows reduce from 26,252 original batch records exactly. AV has no recorded F query norms; all 900 corresponding CSV cells are blank.

Scope is one RGBNT100 normal full-modality benchmark, seed42, two controls, each with original teacher50 plus fresh extra50. Original DeMo alone has 50 epochs, so that baseline is not a matched total-compute comparison. AX/AV ordinary and structured controls have matched additional budgets and exactly matched epoch/step/name/partial-set order.

Epoch selection uses the same official normal Q/G benchmark later reported. The six metrics are from one selected checkpoint, but this is not an untouched independent final test or independent confirmation across seeds.
Eight state cases are frozen interventions on two selected checkpoints. Their 1,715 repeated queries, duplicated normal11 caches, and shared frozen00 are not independent runs or retrained ablations.

AX structured mAP/Rank-1 = 85.92371119067046/96.5597667638484. Its changes versus AV structured are -0.23093211094763433/-0.2332361516034922 pp; versus AX ordinary they are -0.09424600970130825/-0.2332361516034922 pp. AX ordinary mAP/Rank-1 = 86.01795720037177/96.7930029154519. Neither AX control reaches the required +1 mAP and +1 Rank-1 over original DeMo.

Gradient and pre/post query-norm traces establish recorded scale/gradient behavior, not foreground localization, identity usefulness, the cause of the retrieval deficit, or an old-Adam counterfactual replay. AV missing F-query norms preclude a measured AV-to-AX F-query-norm ratio.

The 15-model history and 20,580 paired-delta rows have checked internal arithmetic. Only five supplied primary training results and the AX raw matrices are directly tied here; old historical raw retrieval outputs were not reaudited. No new missing/49, multiseed, robustness, novelty or current remote-preservation claim is supported by this audit.

The reported retrieval evaluation uses dataset-provided filename identities/cameras. Frozen-state results remain real_gt evaluations with fixed-checkpoint intervention limits. Training query-norm/QKV traces are diagnostics, not a separate accuracy benchmark.

scope_limitations: No dataset images or current remote filesystem were read.
Rank metrics independently reconstructed from saved distance matrices; distances were not regenerated from feature dot products.
Checkpoint ZIP payloads CRC/SHA read only; no pickle/torch deserialization or architecture execution.
Duplicate normal11 cache and common frozen base00 matrices are comparisons, not independent data.
AV training traces fully reduced here; no AV original rank matrices were supplied or reaudited.
15-row history arithmetic is checked, but only five models have supplied primary training results; historical secondary tables are not elevated to independent raw evidence.

All checkpoints and data were read locally. No SSH, GPU query, model/optimizer construction, neural forward, training/evaluation entry point, installation, Git operation, source mutation or delegation was performed.
Only the 22 listed original-sealed files were directly rehashed against the full 313-entry original seal maps; the other 291 map entries were not opened by this reviewer.
All feature members were structurally inspected and CRC/SHA read; full feature norm or feature-dot-product distance regeneration was not performed.
A scene=-1 placeholder is not evidence of multiple scenes. Repeated query identities and cached matrices are not statistically independent samples.
